critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the 'Main deck window row' geometry along the Z-axis by 15% to create a second row; apply a radial sweep of 12 degrees to the upper deck windows to follow the fuselage curvature; extrude four rectangular planes (0.8m x 2.4m) onto the fuselage side to define door frames; and scale/reposition the nose window cluster by 3x to form a wrap-around cockpit pane structure.

discrepancies.reference: The upper deck windows follow a distinct convex curve over the cockpit area.
